A spread is a large amount of something spread in front of you. This is most often food of many types.

If something spreads, the area it covers gets larger.
If you spread two or more things, you move them away from each other.
A sprout is a new growth on a plant.
If something is sprouting, it is growing from a seed.
If something sprouts, it is emerging randomly from a surface.
A spruce is a kind of evergreen tree.

ko: ...와 일치하다.(with) [To adjust or adapt so as to bring into harmony with something.]

A stance is the posture of how someone stands.
A staple is a very basic and important supply of something.
A staple is a tool used to fasten stacks of paper securely together.
When you staple something, you sort it according to its staple.
When you staple paper, you secure it with a staple.
If something is static, it does not change.
If something is static, it does not move.
A statue is a model of somebody or something.

ko: 제정법(制定法) (입법부를 통과, 일정한 절차를 거쳐서 발효된 법률. 법원의 판례를 법으로 인정하는 국가에 있어서의 판례법(case law) 또는 정부기관에 의해서 제정되는 규칙, 시행령, 시행규칙(regulation)과 구별된다.)
en: A statute is a law.
A stench is a strong foul smell.
A sterile person or animal cannot make babies, even if they have sex.
If something is sterile it has no living things, especially bacteria.
The stigma of a plant is the sticky part of a flower that receives pollen during pollination.
A stigma is a negative representation of something.
If a person is stingy, they are mean and unwilling to spend; not generous.
A stitch is a little circle of thread, used to join cloth together.
If you stitch something, you make stitches in it.
If you stitch something, you sew it.
To be able to tolerate something emotionally, physically, or mentally; to be able to stand or handle something.
A storey is a floor or level in a building.
A tune, melody or song.
In biology, a particular species or type of animal or microbe.
Extreme effort to do some work.
You strain when it is difficult to do something and you must work hard to do it.
To force something or apply a force.
To remove one part of a mixture from another by filtering it.
A strand is the shore of the sea or ocean.
A strand is a single thin length of fibre or wire.
If you strand your boat, you drive it aground on the shore.
If you strand a person, you leave them in a difficult situation.
A road in a city with buildings on the sides and places where people can walk.

ko: (육체적, 정신적) 힘, 힘의 세기, 기운, 강렬함.
en: If you have strength, you are strong.
If you have strength your muscles are very powerful.
Strength can also mean you are strong or tough is some other way, such as a strong mind or strong will.
Stress is emotional pressure that makes you worry because things are not going well.
Stress is physical pressure that gradually can cause things to break

If you stress a word, part of a word, or a note in music, you make it louder than other words or notes.

A statement is a stretch when it is changed or exaggerated from the truth.
To pull; to move one end of something as far as possible from the other end.
Fill a certain place
A stride is a long step.
The length or type of a step.
The length or type of way that a person walks.
When a group of people stop working to improve or defend their working conditions or pay, they go on strike.
A string is a long, thin and flexible cord that is used for tying.
A string is something that is long and can be bent.
A string is a group of things positioned or stuck together in a line.
To string something is to put it on a string or line.
To string something is to put strings on it.
To string something is to tie or hang it.
A long, thin part of something which is a different colour from the parts beside it.
To mark with stripes.
If you strive, you struggle or try something very hard.
If you stroke something, you touch something with the hand, and move your hand gently up it.
Having big muscles; physically powerful.
Having a smell or flavor that is easy to notice.
Having a specified number of people or units.
If something or someone is stupid, it shows a lack of clear thought.
If something is sturdy, it is solid, strong or firm.
If something or someone is sturdy, they are solid in structure or personality.
To make someone do something unpleasant
A subset is a collection of things that is a part of another larger collection of things.
Subtle means small, slight, not easily noticed, understated.
A suburb is the area around a city where people live.
If something succeeds, it has happened the way somebody wants it to happen.
If you succeed, people recognize that you are good at what you do.
If x succeeds y, x replaces y.
If you succumb to something, you fail to resist the desire or temptation.
If a person succumbs to their injuries, they die.
A sucker is something that sucks, in the sense that it sucks fluid from something.
A sucker is someone who is easy to trick or deceive. They are gullible.
A sucker is another word for a lollipop. It can also mean any candy that you suck on.
Very quick; taking no time or almost no time, and being a surprise.
If something is suffice, it is enough or sufficient to meet the requirements of anything.

A suffix is an affix that is added to the end of a word. In English this can change the meaning. Also, it can be required by grammar but not change the meaning; this could be to change the tense, the number, or for other reasons.
A chemical element (symbol S) with an atomic number of 16.
A yellowish-green color, like that of sulfur.
The part of the year when the weather is hot.
If you summon someone, you call on him to appear before you.
If a police officer or other law enforcement official summons a person, he is accusing him of a crime but not arresting him, and instead demanding he appear in court to respond to the accusation.
The third-person singular form of summon.
It is the part of the day when the sun disappears on the western horizon.
To be superb, something must be the very best, grand, excellent and the very best quality.

ko: [종종 pl.] 공급품, 지급물, 준비품; 공급량, 지급량
en: A supply is an amount of something that you can use when you need it.
Supplies are things like food, water, medicine, gasoline, etc. that people need when they are not near somewhere where they can get them easily.
Supply is the act or system of supplying something.
If you supply something, you make it available, usually regularly.
To keep something up; to be a base for something.
To give someone food and other things the person needs.
When you suppose something, you guess that it is true.
You use I suppose to show that you agree weakly with something.
You use I don't suppose to ask a question, especially when you think the answer is no.
If you survey something, you look at it to try to see or understand the whole of it.
If you survey people about their thoughts or personal information, you ask a large number of people in a formal way, often using a questionnaire.
If you survey a place, you look at every part of it, often from a high spot.

ko: (타동사)(피해·손실·충격 등을) 받다, 입다;경험하다. (To experience or suffer (an injury, etc.). )
(타동사)(법률) (주장 등의 유효성을) 인정하다 (To confirm, prove, or corroborate. )
en: If something is sustained, it is maintained.
To provide for or nourish (something).
If something sustains (an injury etc.), it experiences or suffers (from an injury etc.).
A part of the grammar of a language. Syntax is the rules for putting words together to make a sentence.
Syntax is the formal rules of formulating statements of a computer language.

ko: (가산) [주로 복수로] (어떤 일을 달성하기 위한) 전략, 작전
en: A tactic is an action or plan to achieve a specific goal.
A tactic is a maneuver used against an enemy.
If something is tampered with, it is changed or altered without permission.

ko: (두 명이 앞뒤로 탈 수 있는) 2인용 자전거
en: A tandem is a bicycle with seats and pedals for two people. but only the person in front able to steer. (Also a called "a tandem bike").
If two things happen or if you do two thing (in) tandem, they happen at the same time, together.
A tandem vehicle or activity is one in which two people cooperate to drive or do it.
A tariff is a tax charged on the imports or exports of a country.
Many countries added tariffs to foreign goods during the Great Depression for protectionism of their own goods.
A tattoo is an image made in the skin with ink and a needle.
Tattoo is a method of decorating the skin by inserting colored substances under the surface.
A tattoo is a drum performance or display.
If a person is being tattooed, a tattoo is being applied on the skin of the person.
A tavern is building that has a bar, where alcoholic drinks are sold.
A teapot is a vessel for brewing and serving tea.

ko: 영화, 음악 비디오 등을 선전하기 위해 제작한 짧은 동영상 광고.
en: A teaser is a preview of a product, such as a movie, released before its main release or opening.
A brain teaser is very difficult question.
A teaser is someone who teases others.

ko: 세입자, 임차인, 소작인 〔 One who pays a fee (rent) in return for the use of land, buildings, or other property owned by others. 〕
en: A tenant is a person who occupies the land or house from a landlord. He pays money to a landlord as rent.

ko: 세입자, 임차인, 소작인 〔 One who pays a fee (rent) in return for the use of land, buildings, or other property owned by others. 〕
en: If someone tenants a place, they are occupying it as a tenant.
A tender is an offer to do something at a fixed price.
Tennis is a sport where players use a racquet to hit a ball over a net. It can be played by two or four people.
Very strong or intense fear.
Something that causes such fear.
Violence or the threat of violence for political reasons; terrorism.
Thanks are kind words and thoughts for people who did nice things for you.
A theory is an idea that tries to explain an observation.
When you are thirsty, you feel like you need to have a drink.
The number 30.
A thread is a long, very thin, soft material used to join or make cloth.
A thread is a process.
A thread is a group of messages from a discussion on an Internet forum.
If you thread something, then you make a string or thread out of it.
A threat is something or someone that might be bad or dangerous, or cause a problem.
A threat is the words somebody uses to tell you they will do something bad to you unless you do what they want you to.
Your throat is a tube inside your neck. It takes air from your mouth to your lungs.

ko: 왕이 앉는 자리, 왕좌. (비유) 왕위, 왕권.
en: A ceremonial chair for a sovereign, bishop or leader.
The position of a sovereign or leader itself.
If you thrust, you push forcefully or not carefully.
To thwart is to prevent, frustrate or spoil a person or purpose.

ko: 표. (자동차, 항공기의) 승차권. (전시 또는 공연장의) 입장권, 티켓.
en: A ticket is a piece of paper that allows you to enter a train, airplane, show, etc.
A ticket is a piece of paper that shows that you have parked your car in the wrong place or committed some other driving offence.

ko: 표. (자동차, 항공기의) 승차권. (전시 또는 공연장의) 입장권, 티켓.
en: If you ticket someone, then you give someone a ticket for breaking a law.
The act of tickling.
When you tickle someone, you touch them in a way that makes them laugh.
Timber is trees and forests used as a source of wood.
Timber is wood used for building.
Timber is a piece of wood used in building.
A tinkle is a light metallic sound that resembles the tinkling of bells.
If something tinkles, it makes a light metallic sounds like a small bell.
If a person tiptoes, they walk quietly with only the tips of the toes touching the ground.
A piece of tissue is a sheet of paper that can absorb very well.
Tissue is a group of cells that work together to do a job.
Tobacco is a plant that is used to make cigarettes.

ko: 한 장소로, 하나로 합하여, 결합하여; 전체로서
en: If you say that someone is together, you mean he or she is well organized and focused.
A toilet is something you may put human waste (feces and urine) into.
A toilet is a bathroom.
A tomato is a red, roundish fruit, roughly the size of a fist. It does not have a core nor pips.
A tomato is also the plant bearing tomatoes.
The matter which tomatoes are made of.

ko: 쓰러지다, 무너지다, 넘어지다, 전복하다: 쓰러뜨리다, 무너뜨리다, 넘어뜨리다.
en: If you topple something, you push it over or defeat it.

(철도·선박·항공기 등에 의한) 교통 운수업;(화물의) 운수;운임 수입
en: Traffic is the things that move along a path, especially cars on a road.

If something is unsafe, it is not safe.

Good for a purpose. If something is useful it can be used for something.
The uterus is the internal organ inside of a female mammal where an embryo grows into an infant ready to be born.

A vacuum is an area in space where no matter can be found.
A vacuum is another name for a vacuum cleaner.
If you vacuum, you clean something with a vacuum cleaner.
A vagina is a tube that goes from the vulva to the uterus of female mammals.
An long, low area between hills or mountains, often with a river running through it.
The area which drains into a river.
Any structure resembling #1, for example, the point where two angled roofs meet.
A mythical person who is dead but acts alive and drinks blood.

A person who seems to take your energy; that is, they make you tired.
If you vanish, you disappear suddenly.
If something vanishes, it becomes equal to zero.
Vanity is the feeling of being too proud about their actions, looks or possessions.
Something that is meaningless or pointless.
A hand basin with a cupboard under it, usually found in a bathroom.
A variety of things is a group of things that are not all the same.
Variety is the quality of not being the same.
A variety is one kind of something, especially plants and animals.

A vendor is a person or a company that sells things.

To verify something is to get evidence to show that it is true.

en: A version is something that exists in different forms.
When something is viable, it can be done or used.

Someone who is visiting.

A wanker is a person who shows off too much (is too proud).
If a person is wanted, they are being looked for by the police for commiting a crime.

The clothes you have.
A collection of costumes in a theatrical company.
Weakness is the condition of being weak.
A weakness is a fault.

A weasel is a small, thin animal that eats meat.

A machine used to weld.
Any person who is welding.

If you are wicked you often do evil things. More than that, a wicked person enjoys evil.
A wicked act is something someone does that is very evil.
If something is wicked, it is excellent.
If something is done widely, it is done to a great extent or a large amount; it is commonly done.

A winner is someone that has won a competition, or often wins.

Winter is the coldest season of the year. In northern countries, December, January and February are winter months.
Wisdom is the skillful use of knowledge and insight to make a good decision.

A worker is a person who works, usually for money.
If something is worthy, it has value or worth.

ko: (꽃, 잎을) 엮어서 둥글게 만들다. 화환으로 장식하다.

One of the colors people can see
Yogurt is a creamy, white food that is made when bacteria is added to milk.
A youthful person is an older person who seems young.

ko: (서수사) 영번 째. 한국어에는 없는 서수. (부록: 영어 수사)
en: Something is zeroth place is in a position that precedes the first.
If something moves zigzag, it moves forward, while at the same time going left and right a little.
If something zigzags, it moves or twists in a zigzag manner.
The abdomen is the front part of the lower torso containing many internal organs.
The abdomen is the last of the three parts of an insect's body.
An abetter is a person who helps someone do a crime.
An abettor is a person who helps someone do a crime.
If something is abiding, it always exists.

If a woman has an abortion, her pregnancy is ended deliberately.
An abrasion is a scraped spot or area.

If someone is absorbed, they are deep in thought; they are engrossed.

If something is abysmal, it is very bad or poor.

An accolade is an acknowledgement given to someone for something they did.

승인하다, 인가하다 〔To send with letters credential, as an ambassador, envoy, or diplomatic agent; to authorize, as a messenger or delegate. 〕
en: If you accredit someone, you give credit to them for something they did.
If a governmental body accredits a school, they certify that the school has met a certain standard.
The accused is a person who is on trial for some crime.
If something is acerbic, it tastes sour.
Acetone is a colourless, volatile, flammable liquid that is mainly used as a solvent.

ko: 신 맛의 정도, 산성도(酸性度), 산(酸)이 있는 상태.
en: The quality or state of being acid.
The quality of sour; sourness to the taste, as in the acidity of lemon juice.
Excessive acid quality, as in gastric secretions.
An acrobat is an athlete who performs tricks requiring strength and balance, often in circuses or shows.

ko: 여러 낱말로 이루어진 표현에서 각 낱말의 첫 글자를 따서 만들어진 조합을 발음하는 말. 보통 '약자'로 취급한다.
en: An acronym is an abbreviation usually made by the first letters of a series of words, and which is itself said as a word
An actress is a female who performs as a character in a play or other theatrical work.

ko: 변환 플러그; 전압이 다른 기기나 기계 따위를 연결하는 부품을 통틀어 일컫는 말.
en: An adaptor is an adapter.
If something is adherent, it is adhesive and sticks to something.
An adherent is a person who supports or follows a group, association or religion.
If you adjourn a meeting, you end it.

ko: 부가물, 부속물 (An appendage; something attached to something else in a subordinate capacity.)
en: archaic: attendant upon

ko: 부가물, 부속물 (An appendage; something attached to something else in a subordinate capacity.)
en: An adjunct is something less important that is joined with something else.
